run_craftassist_swarm_master: run the CraftAssistSwarmMaster agent to orchestrate multiple Minecraft swarm workers via command line
init_controller_swarm_master: initialize the CraftAssistSwarmMaster dialogue manager with bot capabilities, interpreter, and memory handlers
assign_task_to_worker: assign a named task with data to a specific swarm worker or execute it directly on the master
handle_memory_query: handle memory queries from swarm workers by routing them to the appropriate memory node handler
step_assign_new_tasks_to_workers: step through and assign new priority tasks to available swarm workers based on their tags
